blocked.msg: The door is boarded and you can't remove the boards.

rooms.desc: You are standing in an open field west of a white house, with a boarded front door.
rooms.name: West of House

rooms.desc: You are standing in front of a massive barrow of stone. In the east face is a huge stone door which is open. You cannot see into the dark of the tomb.
rooms.name: Stone Barrow

blocked.msg: The windows are all boarded.

rooms.desc: You are facing the north side of a white house. There is no door here, and all the windows are boarded up. To the north a narrow path winds through the trees.
rooms.name: North of House

blocked.msg: The windows are all boarded.

rooms.desc: You are facing the south side of a white house. There is no door here, and all the windows are boarded.
rooms.name: South of House

rooms.desc: You are behind the white house. A path leads into the forest to the east. In one corner of the house there is a small window which is

exits.cond: if the kitchen window is open
if the kitchen window is open

rooms.name: Behind House

blocked.msg: There is no tree here suitable for climbing.
You would need a machete to go further west.

rooms.desc: This is a forest, with trees in all directions. To the east, there appears to be sunlight.
rooms.name: Forest

blocked.msg: There is no tree here suitable for climbing.
The forest becomes impenetrable to the north.

rooms.desc: This is a dimly lit forest, with large trees all around.
rooms.name: Forest

blocked.msg: The mountains are impassable.
The mountains are impassable.

rooms.desc: The forest thins out, revealing impassable mountains.
rooms.name: Forest

blocked.msg: There is no tree here suitable for climbing.
The rank undergrowth prevents eastward movement.
Storm-tossed trees block your way.

rooms.desc: This is a dimly lit forest, with large trees all around.
rooms.name: Forest

rooms.desc: This is a path winding through a dimly lit forest. The path heads north-south here. One particularly large tree with some low branches stands at the edge of the path.
rooms.name: Forest Path

blocked.msg: You cannot climb any higher.

rooms.desc: You are about 10 feet above the ground nestled among some large branches. The nearest branch above you is above your reach.
rooms.name: Up a Tree

blocked.msg: The forest becomes impenetrable to the north.

rooms.desc: You are in a clearing, with a forest surrounding you on all sides. A path leads south.
rooms.name: Clearing

blocked.msg: There is no tree here suitable for climbing.

rooms.desc: You are in a small clearing in a well marked forest path that extends to the east and west.
rooms.name: Clearing

rooms.desc: You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is

exits.cond: if the kitchen window is open
if the kitchen window is open

rooms.name: Kitchen

rooms.desc: This is the attic. The only exit is a stairway leading down.
rooms.name: Attic

rooms.desc: You are in the living room. There is a doorway to the east

exits.cond: if the trap door is open

rooms.name: Living Room

blocked.msg: You try to ascend the ramp, but it is impossible, and you slide back down.

rooms.desc: You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading north, and a crawlway to the south. On the west is the bottom of a steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

exits.cond: if the trap door is open

rooms.name: Cellar

rooms.desc: This is a small room with passages to the east and south and a forbidding hole leading west. Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the walls.
rooms.name: The Troll Room

blocked.msg: The chasm probably leads straight to the infernal regions.

rooms.desc: You are on the east edge of a chasm, the bottom of which cannot be seen. A narrow passage goes north, and the path you are on continues to the east.
rooms.name: East of Chasm

rooms.desc: This is an art gallery. Most of the paintings have been stolen by vandals with exceptional taste. The vandals left through either the north or west exits.
rooms.name: Gallery

blocked.msg: The way is decided by Up Chimney Function.

rooms.desc: This appears to have been an artist's studio. The walls and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here. At the south end of the room is an open door (also covered with paint). A dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back down.
rooms.name: Studio

rooms.desc: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.name: Maze

rooms.desc: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.name: Maze

rooms.desc: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.name: Maze

rooms.desc: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.name: Maze

rooms.desc: You have come to a dead end in the maze.
rooms.name: Dead End

rooms.desc: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike. A skeleton, probably the remains of a luckless adventurer, lies here.
rooms.name: Maze

rooms.desc: You have come to a dead end in the maze.
rooms.name: Dead End

rooms.desc: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.name: Maze

rooms.desc: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.name: Maze

rooms.desc: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.

rooms.name: Dead End

rooms.name: Maze

rooms.name: Maze

rooms.desc: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.name: Maze

rooms.desc: You are in a small room near the maze. There are twisty passages in the immediate vicinity.
rooms.name: Grating Room

rooms.desc: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.name: Maze

rooms.desc: You have come to a dead end in the maze.
rooms.name: Dead End

rooms.desc: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.name: Maze

rooms.desc: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.name: Maze

rooms.desc: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.name: Maze

rooms.desc: This room has an exit on the northwest, and a staircase leading up.
rooms.name: Cyclops Room

rooms.desc: This is a long passage. To the west is one entrance. On the east there is an old wooden door, with a large opening in it (about cyclops sized).
rooms.name: Strange Passage

rooms.desc: This is a large room, whose east wall is solid granite. A number of discarded bags, which crumble at your touch, are scattered about on the floor. There is an exit down a staircase.
rooms.name: Treasure Room

rooms.desc: You are in a long room, to the north of which was formerly a lake. However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream running through the center of the room.
rooms.name: Reservoir South

blocked.msg: The dam blocks your way.

rooms.desc: You are on what used to be a large lake, but which is now a large mud pile. There are \"shores\" to the north and south.
rooms.name: Reservoir

rooms.desc: You are in a large cavernous room, the south of which was formerly a lake. However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream running through there.
rooms.name: Reservoir North

blocked.msg: The stream emerges from a spot too small for you to enter.

rooms.desc: You are standing on a path beside a gently flowing stream. The path follows the stream, which flows from west to east.
rooms.name: Stream View

blocked.msg: The channel is too narrow.
The channel is too narrow.

rooms.desc: You are on the gently flowing stream. The upstream route is too narrow to navigate, and the downstream route is invisible due to twisting walls. There is a narrow beach to land on.
rooms.name: Stream

rooms.desc: You are in a large square room with tall ceilings. On the south wall is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall. There are exits on the other three sides of the room.
rooms.name: Mirror Room

rooms.desc: You are in a large square room with tall ceilings. On the south wall is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall. There are exits on the other three sides of the room.
rooms.name: Mirror Room

rooms.desc: This is a tiny cave with entrances west and north, and a staircase leading down.
rooms.name: Cave

rooms.desc: This is a tiny cave with entrances west and north, and a dark, forbidding staircase leading down.
rooms.name: Cave

rooms.desc: This is a cold and damp corridor where a long east-west passageway turns into a southward path.
rooms.name: Cold Passage

rooms.desc: This is a long and narrow corridor where a long north-south passageway briefly narrows even further.
rooms.name: Narrow Passage

rooms.desc: This is a winding passage. It seems that there are only exits on the east and north.
rooms.name: Winding Passage

rooms.desc: This is a winding passage. It seems that there are only exits on the east and north.
rooms.name: Twisting Passage

rooms.desc: This is an ancient room, long under water. There is an exit to the south and a staircase leading up.
rooms.name: Atlantis Room

rooms.desc: This is a narrow east-west passageway. There is a narrow stairway leading down at the north end of the room.
rooms.name: East-West Passage

rooms.desc: This is a circular stone room with passages in all directions. Several of them have unfortunately been blocked by cave-ins.
rooms.name: Round Room

rooms.desc: You are on the south edge of a deep canyon. Passages lead off to the east, northwest and southwest. A stairway leads down.
rooms.name: Deep Canyon

blocked.msg: It is too narrow for most insects.

rooms.desc: This cave has exits to the west and east, and narrows to a crack toward the south. The earth is particularly damp here.
rooms.name: Damp Cave

rooms.desc: This is a large room with a ceiling which cannot be detected from the ground. There is a narrow passage from east to west and a stone stairway leading upward.
rooms.name: Loud Room

rooms.desc: This is a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
rooms.name: North-South Passage

blocked.msg: Are you out of your mind?

rooms.desc: A chasm runs southwest to northeast and the path follows it. You are on the south side of the chasm, where a crack opens into a passage.
rooms.name: Chasm

rooms.desc: You are outside a large gateway, on which is inscribed|| Abandon every hope all ye who enter here!|| The gate is open; through it you can see a desolation, with a pile of mangled bodies in one corner. Thousands of voices, lamenting some hideous fate, can be heard.
rooms.name: Entrance to Hades

rooms.desc: You have entered the Land of the Living Dead. Thousands of lost souls can be heard weeping and moaning. In the corner are stacked the remains of dozens of previous adventurers less fortunate than yourself. A passage exits to the north.
rooms.name: Land of the Dead

rooms.desc: You have entered a low cave with passages leading northwest and east.
rooms.name: Engravings Cave

rooms.desc: This is a room which looks like an Egyptian tomb. There is an ascending staircase to the west.
rooms.name: Egyptian Room

rooms.desc: You are at the periphery of a large dome, which forms the ceiling of another room below. Protecting you from a precipitous drop is a wooden railing which circles the dome.
rooms.name: Dome Room

blocked.msg: You cannot reach the rope.

rooms.desc: This is a large room with a prominent doorway leading to a down staircase. Above you is a large dome. Up around the edge of the dome (20 feet up) is a wooden railing. In the center of the room sits a white marble pedestal.
rooms.name: Torch Room

rooms.desc: This is the north end of a large temple. On the east wall is an ancient inscription, probably a prayer in a long-forgotten language. Below the prayer is a staircase leading down. The west wall is solid granite. The exit to the north end of the room is through huge marble pillars.
rooms.name: Temple

rooms.desc: This is the south end of a large temple. In front of you is what appears to be an altar. In one corner is a small hole in the floor which leads into darkness. You probably could not get back up it.
rooms.name: Altar

rooms.desc: You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was quite a tourist attraction in times far distant. There are paths to the north, south, and west, and a scramble down.
rooms.name: Dam

rooms.desc: This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring the dam. There are open doorways here to the north and east marked \"Private\", and there is a path leading south over the top of the dam.
rooms.name: Dam Lobby

rooms.desc: This is what appears to have been the maintenance room for Flood Control Dam #3. Apparently, this room has been ransacked recently, for most of the valuable equipment is gone. On the wall in front of you is a group of buttons colored blue, yellow, brown, and red. There are doorways to the west and south.
rooms.name: Maintenance Room

rooms.desc: You are at the base of Flood Control Dam #3, which looms above you and to the north. The river Frigid is flowing by here. Along the river are the White Cliffs which seem to form giant walls stretching from north to south along the shores of the river as it winds its way downstream.
rooms.name: Dam Base

blocked.msg: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.
The White Cliffs prevent your landing here.

rooms.desc: You are on the Frigid River in the vicinity of the Dam. The river flows quietly here. There is a landing on the west shore.
rooms.name: Frigid River

blocked.msg: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.
There is no safe landing spot here.
The White Cliffs prevent your landing here.
Just in time you steer away from the rocks.

rooms.desc: The river turns a corner here making it impossible to see the Dam. The White Cliffs loom on the east bank and large rocks prevent landing on the west.
rooms.name: Frigid River

blocked.msg: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.

rooms.desc: The river descends here into a valley. There is a narrow beach on the west shore below the cliffs. In the distance a faint rumbling can be heard.
rooms.name: Frigid River

rooms.desc: You are on a narrow strip of beach which runs along the base of the White Cliffs. There is a narrow path heading south along the Cliffs and a tight passage leading west into the cliffs themselves.
rooms.name: White Cliffs Beach

rooms.desc: You are on a rocky, narrow strip of beach beside the Cliffs. A narrow path leads north along the shore.
rooms.name: White Cliffs Beach

blocked.msg: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.
You can land either to the east or the west.

rooms.desc: The river is running faster here and the sound ahead appears to be that of rushing water. On the east shore is a sandy beach. A small area of beach can also be seen below the cliffs on the west shore.
rooms.name: Frigid River

blocked.msg: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.

rooms.desc: The sound of rushing water is nearly unbearable here. On the east shore is a large landing area.
rooms.name: Frigid River

rooms.desc: You are on the east shore of the river. The water here seems somewhat treacherous. A path travels from north to south here, the south end quickly turning around a sharp corner.
rooms.name: Shore

rooms.desc: You are on a large sandy beach on the east shore of the river, which is flowing quickly by. A path runs beside the river to the south here, and a passage is partially buried in sand to the northeast.
rooms.name: Sandy Beach

rooms.desc: This is a sand-filled cave whose exit is to the southwest.
rooms.name: Sandy Cave

blocked.msg: It's a long way...

rooms.desc: You are at the top of Aragain Falls, an enormous waterfall with a drop of about 450 feet. The only path here is on the north end.
rooms.name: Aragain Falls

rooms.desc: You are on top of a rainbow (I bet you never thought you would walk on a rainbow), with a magnificent view of the Falls. The rainbow travels east-west here.
rooms.name: On the Rainbow

rooms.desc: You are on a small, rocky beach on the continuation of the Frigid River past the Falls. The beach is narrow due to the presence of the White Cliffs. The river canyon opens here and sunlight shines in from above. A rainbow crosses over the falls to the east and a narrow path continues to the southwest.
rooms.name: End of Rainbow

rooms.desc: You are beneath the walls of the river canyon which may be climbable here. The lesser part of the runoff of Aragain Falls flows by below. To the north is a narrow path.
rooms.name: Canyon Bottom

rooms.desc: You are on a ledge about halfway up the wall of the river canyon. You can see from here that the main flow from Aragain Falls twists along a passage which it is impossible for you to enter. Below you is the canyon bottom. Above you is more cliff, which appears climbable.
rooms.name: Rocky Ledge

blocked.msg: Storm-tossed trees block your way.

rooms.desc: You are at the top of the Great Canyon on its west wall. From here there is a marvelous view of the canyon and parts of the Frigid River upstream. Across the canyon, the walls of the White Cliffs join the mighty ramparts of the Flathead Mountains to the east. Following the Canyon upstream to the north, Aragain Falls may be seen, complete with rainbow. The mighty Frigid River flows out from a great dark cavern. To the west and south can be seen an immense forest, stretching for miles around. A path leads northwest. It is possible to climb down into the canyon from here.
rooms.name: Canyon View

rooms.desc: You are standing at the entrance of what might have been a coal mine. The shaft enters the west wall, and there is another exit on the south end of the room.
rooms.name: Mine Entrance

rooms.desc: You are in a small room. Strange squeaky sounds may be heard coming from the passage at the north end. You may also escape to the east.
rooms.name: Squeaky Room

rooms.desc: You are in a small room which has doors only to the east and south.
rooms.name: Bat Room

blocked.msg: You wouldn't fit and would die if you could.

rooms.desc: This is a large room, in the middle of which is a small shaft descending through the floor into darkness below. To the west and the north are exits from this room. Constructed over the top of the shaft is a metal framework to which a heavy iron chain is attached.
rooms.name: Shaft Room

rooms.desc: This is a small nondescript room. However, from the direction of a small descending staircase a foul odor can be detected. To the south is a narrow tunnel.
rooms.name: Smelly Room

rooms.desc: This is a small room which smells strongly of coal gas. There is a short climb up some stairs and a narrow tunnel leading east.
rooms.name: Gas Room

rooms.desc: This is a very small room. In the corner is a rickety wooden ladder, leading downward. It might be safe to descend. There is also a staircase leading upward.
rooms.name: Ladder Top

rooms.desc: This is a rather wide room. On one side is the bottom of a narrow wooden ladder. To the west and the south are passages leaving the room.
rooms.name: Ladder Bottom

rooms.desc: You have come to a dead end in the mine.
rooms.name: Dead End

rooms.desc: This is a long and narrow passage, which is cluttered with broken timbers. A wide passage comes from the east and turns at the west end of the room into a very narrow passageway. From the west comes a strong draft.
rooms.name: Timber Room

rooms.desc: This is a small drafty room in which is the bottom of a long shaft. To the south is a passageway and to the east a very narrow passage. In the shaft can be seen a heavy iron chain.
rooms.name: Drafty Room

rooms.desc: This is a large, cold room whose sole exit is to the north. In one corner there is a machine which is reminiscent of a clothes dryer. On its face is a switch which is labelled \"START\". The switch does not appear to be manipulable by any human hand (unless the fingers are about 1/16 by 1/4 inch). On the front of the machine is a large lid, which is
rooms.name: Machine Room

rooms.desc: This is a nondescript part of a coal mine.
rooms.name: Coal Mine

rooms.desc: This is a nondescript part of a coal mine.
rooms.name: Coal Mine

rooms.desc: This is a nondescript part of a coal mine.
rooms.name: Coal Mine

rooms.desc: This is a nondescript part of a coal mine.
rooms.name: Coal Mine

rooms.desc: This is a small chamber, which appears to have been part of a coal mine. On the south wall of the chamber the letters \"Granite Wall\" are etched in the rock. To the east is a long passage, and there is a steep metal slide twisting downward. To the north is a small opening.
rooms.name: Slide Room
